metaDescription: Manage catalog services for PR Per Hour administrators.
lead: Create, edit, activate, and soft-delete services in the catalog.
limitationBody: The admin list returns active and inactive services only. Soft-deleted rows are excluded by the API, so there is no browsable restore list. After you delete a service, use Restore while the success notice is visible. Restoring an older deleted service requires its numeric id from another source.
title: Title
isActiveCreateHint: Inactive services stay hidden from the public catalog.
isActiveEditHint: Status changes use the dedicated status endpoint when you save.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
durationHint: Optional whole minutes. Leave empty for none.
priceHint: Decimal string with up to two places (for example 100.50). Kept as text—no floating-point conversion.
currencyHint: Uppercase letters/numbers, max 10 characters. Defaults to USD when omitted on create.
createDescription: Add a catalog service. Slug must be unique. Inactive categories are allowed.
editDescription: Update service fields or active status.
deleteDescription: Soft-delete “{{title}}”? It will leave public and admin lists until restored.
softDeleteNote: This is a soft delete. The service is hidden, not permanently removed. Bookings are not deleted. There is no force-delete action in this UI.
emptyDescription: Create a service to populate the catalog.
filteredEmptyDescription: No services match these filters. Reset filters or create a new service.
listErrorDescription: The service list could not be loaded. Try again.
categoriesFilterError: Categories could not be loaded for filtering.
categoriesFormError: Categories could not be loaded. Retry before creating or updating a service.
validationTitleMax: Title must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationSlugMax: Slug must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationSlugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
validationDurationInteger: Duration must be a whole number of minutes (0 or greater).
validationPriceFormat: Enter a non-negative price with up to two decimal places (max 99999999.99).
validationCurrencyMax: Currency must be 10 characters or fewer.
validationCurrencyFormat: Use uppercase letters and numbers only.
errorUnauthorized: Your session is not authorized. Sign in again as an admin.
errorForbidden: You do not have permission to manage services.
errorConflict: This service conflicts with an existing record (for example a duplicate slug).
errorCategoryUnavailable: The related category is unavailable (for example soft-deleted). Restore cannot complete.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errorServer: The server could not complete this request. Try again later.
